name: Arr Watch
overview: Optional Radarr and Sonarr integrations for Jellyfin Web.
description: Combines confirmed Radarr digital movie releases and monitored Sonarr season premieres for JellySpotlight. Radarr movie status for Jellyfin Enhanced remains available.

versions.changelog: Rebuild Arr Watch for Jellyfin 12.0 final, .NET 10 and File Transformation 3.0 so Radarr digital releases and Sonarr season premieres remain available to JellySpotlight.

Fix Sonarr season artwork by falling back to Sonarr's remote image URL when its local MediaCover cache cannot serve a valid image. External fallback is restricted to trusted HTTPS TVDB and TMDB image hosts.

Rename Radarr Watch to Arr Watch and add independent Sonarr support. Coming soon now combines confirmed future digital movie releases with monitored season premieres while excluding specials and later episodes.
